uzo.purpose: Fills an area while its content loads, or when there is none: loading standards, no standards yet; a title (slot heading) says where the person is, an icon (slot icon) what is missing.

instead.kialo: An action that is working is the butono's own loading, because the person waits at the button they pressed; an area loads when its content is not there yet.
Progress of a task in percent is neither a measure like the mezurilo's nor a wait, because it moves by itself; that is an Ero of its own, a person decides.

boundary.kialo: A grey shape of the content to come promises a layout the data may not have, because it is drawn before the data; the text says what loads.

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: A table without rows shows its empty state in place of the rows, because the person looks there for them (tabelo, ④).

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section whose content loads or is empty fills itself with the state, because an empty section says nothing.

with.kialo: An empty state may offer the next step, because 'none yet' asks what to do; a working action is the butono's own loading.
The text of an empty state names what is missing; where it heads the area as a section, the heading is a titolo.

case.de: Gewartet wird auf die Handlung einer Schaltfläche, die gerade arbeitet.
case.en: The wait is for the action of a button that is working.

case.de: Es soll gesagt werden, dass etwas fehlgeschlagen ist.
case.en: It is to be said that something failed.

do.de: Wähle kind loading, solange Inhalt lädt, und kind empty, wenn keiner da ist.
do.en: Choose kind loading while content loads, and kind empty when there is none.

do.de: Sag im leeren Zustand, was als Nächstes zu tun ist, und biete die Aktion dazu an.
do.en: Say in the empty state what to do next, and offer the action for it.

do.de: Nimm compact in einer Tabelle oder Seitenleiste.
do.en: Use compact in a table or a side bar.

dont.de: Aktionen anbieten, während noch geladen wird.
dont.en: Offer actions while it is still loading.

dont.de: Graue Platzhalterformen des kommenden Inhalts zeichnen, denn sie versprechen ein Layout, das die Daten nicht haben müssen.
dont.en: Draw grey placeholder shapes of the coming content, because they promise a layout the data may not have.

none.de: Der Zustand selbst nimmt keine Taste; eine Aktion im leeren Zustand ist eine gewöhnliche Schaltfläche für Enter und Leertaste.
none.en: The state itself takes no key; an action in the empty state is an ordinary button for Enter and Space.
